intentBasis: User authorized the local full architecture program and on 2026-10-01 requested a reusable architecture-first Brain with visual planning, core prioritization and continuous review. Existing source architecture and bounded execution contracts remain authoritative. User 2026-10-01 explicitly created a complete-core actual realtime goal; checkpoint28 selects the continuous local core journey and grounded Brain readiness maintenance. User2026-10-01 ok proceed adopts the next bounded reliability/CI increment after source-grounded verdict review. Preserve local-core completion and unresolved historical startup cause. User2026-10-02 authorizes the reviewed mobile shell build and explicitly defers identity/API profile selection. MOBILE-001 adopts browser-shell/client packaging only; native acceptance remains open. Continued user local core/plugin architecture request and explicit implementation handoff adopt FRAMEWORK-RELIABILITY-001 from actual revision63 failed audit; MOBILE-001 historical acceptance retained.

users: Project owner reviewing direction and delivery
